resolverRules.rule: Platform applies when no junit-platform-runner and a platform marker exists. Marker prefers plugin artifact org.junit.platform:junit-platform-engine, otherwise project org.junit.platform:junit-platform-commons. Use marker.getBaseVersion, not plugin version or a guessed Jupiter-to-Platform mapping
Provider root org.apache.maven.surefire:surefire-junit-platform version comes from getBooterArtifact().getBaseVersion; resolve its runtime closure and explicit plugin dependencies

If explicit plugin deps contain Platform engine, merge them. Otherwise, only API-present/engine-absent adds Jupiter engine matching API version. Vintage is conditional on JUnit4 present, no Vintage, and non-null engineVersion from that API-only branch; do not unconditionally add Vintage

Remove provider map keys already supplied by test deps; still unconditionally resolve junit-platform-launcher at marker baseVersion with runtime transitive dependencies, replacing overlapping provider map keys. Removal of a map key is not a promise the subsequent resolve will be skipped
Aether resolves runtime dependency closure; no arbitrary artifact/profile/repository input is needed
